content: सम् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (समति) .²1 To be confused or agitated. .²2 Not to be confused or agitated. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (समयतिते) To be agitated.

सम् {%ind.%} .²1 (As a prefix to verbs and verbal derivatives it means .³({%a%}) with, together with, together; as in संगम्, संभाषण, संधा, संयुज् <ab>&c.</ab>). .³({%b%}) Sometimes it intensifies the meaning of the simple root, and may be translated by ‘very, quite, greatly, thoroughly, very much’; संतुष्, संतोष, संन्यस्, संन्यास, संताप <ab>&c.</ab>; तस्यामात्मानुरूपायामात्मजन्मसमुत्सुकः <ls>R. 1. 33</ls>. .³({%c%}) It also expresses completeness, perfection, or beauty. .²2 As prefixed to nouns to form <ab>comp.</ab> it means ‘like, same, similar’, as in समर्थ. .²3 Sometimes it means ‘near’, ‘before’, as in समक्ष. .²4 In the Vedas it is sometimes used as a separable preposition (with <ab>instr.</ab>).
